_description: Single-step lookahead IG maximization baseline (paper approach)

greedy_ig._comment: Pure belief-based IG, no penalties: IG=no sharing, IGd=discounted IoU, BS=broadcast single news, BM=per-neighbor news

decentralized._comment_modes: Communication settings - radius_multiplier is multiplied by h_displacement (field_len/2/n_h_act)
decentralized._comment_calc: For 8 agents: n_h_act=8, h_displacement=(50/2)/8=3.125m. radius_multiplier=5 gives 15.625m, =16 gives 50m (unlimited)
